cards.d: If something is antique, it is very old and rare, and therefore valuable.
cards.e: My grandmother’s antique rocking chair is worth a lot of money.

cards.d: An applicant is someone who writes a request to be considered for a job or prize.
cards.e: Lots of applicants came into the store when the job position became available.

cards.d: An artifact is an old object made by humans that is historically interesting.
cards.e: We studied artifacts from an ancient Chinese settlement.

cards.d: When something is authentic, it is not false or a copy of the original.
cards.e: We ate authentic Italian food on our vacation to Rome.

cards.d: The chronology of a series of past events is when they happened.
cards.e: We learned the chronology of World War II in history class.

cards.d: A diplomat is a representative of a country who works with another country.
cards.e: The Spanish diplomat discussed trade issues with officials in Peru.

cards.d: An epic is a long book, poem, or movie about a period of time or a great event.
cards.e: The poet wrote an epic about the great discoveries of the past thousand years.

cards.d: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music taken from a larger piece.
cards.e: I didn’t listen to the entire symphony online, but I did play an excerpt.

cards.d: A fossil is the hard remains of a prehistoric animal or plant.
cards.e: The expert arranged the fossils to build the skeleton of the dinosaur.

cards.d: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed and embarrassed.
cards.e: I was humiliated when I tripped and fell down in front of the whole school.

cards.d: When a poem is considered lyric, it is written in a simple and direct style.
cards.e: I enjoy reading and creating my own lyric poetry.

cards.d: Majesty is supreme greatness or authority.
cards.e: You should address the king and queen as your majesty.

cards.d: The monarch of a country is the king, queen, emperor, or empress.
cards.e: The monarch lived in a beautiful palace with a grand gate.

cards.d: To precede something means to come before it.
cards.e: The hurricane was preceded by a moment of still wind and clear sky.

cards.d: When someone is punctual, they do something or arrive at the right time.
cards.e: My mother hates being late. She is the most punctual person I know.

cards.d: To recruit people means to select them to join or work for an organization.
cards.e: We successfully recruited someone to be the new manager.

cards.d: A refund is money given back to a person when an item is returned to a store.
cards.e: I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.

cards.d: A register is an official list or record of people or things.
cards.e: At a wedding there is a register for all of the guests to sign.

cards.d: Renown is the quality of being well known due to having done good things.
cards.e: Michael is a singer of great renown in New Zealand.

cards.d: A tusk is a long, curved, pointed tooth of an elephant, boar, or walrus.
cards.e: Sadly, some people hunt elephants and remove their tusks to sell them.
